findings.title: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible
findings.comment:
Observed there to be a cloth towel hanging on a hook to the left side of the handwashing sink. PIC stated that the cloth towel was being used for hand drying. Discussed with PIC that cloth towels aren't allowed for hand drying. The towel was removed. Ensure that disposal towels are only used for hand drying and never cloth towels. 

6-301.12: Each HANDWASHING SINK shall be provided with: (A) Individual, disposable towels; (B) A continuous towel system that supplies the user with a clean towel; (C) A heated-air hand drying device; (D) A hand drying device that employs an air-knife system that delivers high velocity, pressurized air at ambient temperatures.

findings.title: Plumbing installed; proper backflow devices
findings.comment:
Observed a leaking pipe at the handwashing sink in the bar area. A ring around the pipe appeared to be loose. PIC tighten that ring to stop the leak. Ensure that pipes are maintained in good repair at all times. 

5-205.15: A PLUMBING SYSTEM shall be: (A) Repaired according to LAW; P and (B) Maintained in good repair.

findings.title: Toilet facilities: properly constructed, supplied, & cleaned
findings.comment:
Observed the trash can in the women’s restroom to not be covered. Ensure that trash cans in women restrooms have covers for sanitary purposes. 

5-501.17: A toilet room used by females shall be provided with a covered receptacle for sanitary napkins.
